channel.title: MassPermits Research
channel.description: Original analysis of Massachusetts building-permit records. Every figure recomputed from the live data, with the method published alongside.

item.title: What 39 Massachusetts towns publish in their permit records
item.description: Every one of the 39 Massachusetts municipal sources behind MassPermits, what each publishes, and what it does not - 28 publish no project value and 2 publish coordinates.

item.title: Methodology - how MassPermits measures Massachusetts permit data
item.description: How MassPermits collects Massachusetts building-permit records, how work is classified, what is deliberately withheld, and the four rules every research page on this site follows.

item.title: Corrections and rejected analyses
item.description: Corrections and rejected analyses. Every figure MassPermits computed, verified and then declined to publish, with the reason it did not survive.

item.title: What permit follows what in Massachusetts, and how long after
item.description: Across 10,817 Massachusetts addresses that filed more than one trade, 12 pairs of trades run reliably one way. A kitchen/bath permit is followed by gas 88% of the time, a median 20 days later.

item.title: Friday is the quietest day in Massachusetts permit records - and in one town it does not exist
item.description: Across 57,321 Massachusetts building permits from 39 municipal sources, Friday accounts for 12.8% of dated records against roughly 22.5% on Tuesday. In Hingham it is zero.

item.title: We could only answer the heat-pump question in 12 of 39 Massachusetts towns
item.description: Across 1,122 heating-system permits in the 12 Massachusetts towns whose records can answer, heat pumps are 37.9% of installations - and range from 13.8% to 71.4%.

item.title: We found 224 accessory-dwelling-unit permits in Massachusetts records - and the apparent boom is not real
item.description: 224 ADU permits across 19 Massachusetts towns. Raw monthly counts climb from 20 to 54, but normalized against the same sources the rate is flat. 19.6% mention a garage.
